title: Put Boxes Into The Warehouse I
description: Place boxes into a warehouse with a given height profile such that no box is taller than the warehouse height at its position.
pseudocode:
1. warehouse[i] = min(warehouse[i], warehouse[i-1])
2. sort boxes ascending
3. i = warehouse.length - 1
4. for box of boxes:
5.   while i >= 0 and warehouse[i] < box:
6.     i--
7.   if i >= 0:
8.     count++, i--

steps.note: Normalize warehouse heights: make each position the minimum height of all positions to its left.
Placed box 1 at position 3, moving to position 2.
Placed box 2 at position 2, moving to position 1.
